name: Seated Knee Tuck
research: Seated on the floor, root 0.12 m (sit bones ~0.02 m after the lean). Start lean 45 deg (root rot X -45): hip L (0.11,-0.034,0.158), shoulders (+-0.22, 0.278, 0.505). Legs out: hip-ankle 0.905 (straight-ish), rising 12 deg: dy = -0.905cos12 = -0.885, dz = +0.188 -> ankle (0.12,-0.919,0.346), heels ~0.27 m up, toes pointed (rot X -20). End lean 38 deg: hip (0.11,-0.038,0.154); thigh 55 deg up -> knee (0.12,-0.30,0.51); shin down-forward -> ankle (0.12,-0.523,0.121): hip-ankle 0.486 -> knee bend ~115 deg, heel ~0.05 m off the floor. Hands planted in both pictures at world (+-0.25, 0.52, 0.035), 0.52 m behind the pelvis joint, fingers toward the feet (axis [-1,0,0]); arm angles solved from shoulder->hand in each torso frame with upper arm 0.269 + forearm-to-hand 0.33: start |S-H| 0.530 -> elbow 56, elev 103, plane -82 (elbow points back); end |S-H| 0.581 -> elbow 29, elev 84, plane -84.5. Source S1 Spotebi (coach), S2 Oliva-Lozano 2020 (V-sit RA ~80%), S3 Escamilla 2006.
